verdict.rationale: The pack never mentions a SigNoz-branded SDK or client library. Instrumentation relies on standard OpenTelemetry SDKs exporting over OTLP (signoz-docs-6, signoz-docs-23). Programmatic access exists only through service-account API credentials and dashboards-as-code (signoz-docs-22, signoz-docs-16), and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every path (signoz-probe-3). Missing for 10: a first-party SigNoz SDK or API client library, a published OpenAPI spec, SDK reference docs or language coverage, and independent corroboration of building against SDKs.
